name: ai-sources
title: AI Sources
description: A "Used N sources" toggle that opens into a numbered list of links, for showing where an answer came from.

props.name: sources
props.description: The pages the answer was built from, each with an id, title, url and optional site.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state when you control it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when you do not control it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the reader opens or closes the list.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
